description: This Java class named PaginationParametersDataValidator is responsible for validating pagination parameters such as 'orderBy' and 'sortOrder' within the Fineract project. It checks whether provided values are supported and throws a validation exception if not.

classes.name: PaginationParametersDataValidator
classes.description: A component class that validates pagination parameter values, ensuring they conform to expected options, specifically 'orderBy' and 'sortOrder'.

methods.name: validateParameterValues
methods.description: Validates the 'orderBy' and 'sortOrder' parameters against supported values and throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Checks if validation errors exist and throws a validation exception if so.
